title: Israel and the US Bomb Iran's Nuclear Sites in a Twelve-Day War
dek: Israel opens a surprise air war on Iran on 13 June 2025; nine days later US bombers hit Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan, and a ceasefire Trump brokers takes hold on 24 June.
body: Twelve days, two air forces, three nuclear sites. Eight months later the United States and Israel struck Iran again.

panels.label: Trump Said
panels.text: Trump said Iran’s key enrichment sites had been “completely and totally obliterated” and that Iran, “the bully of the Middle East, must now make peace.”

panels.label: Khamenei Said
panels.text: Ali Khamenei said “the Islamic Republic slapped America in the face” and that the US strikes failed to “achieve anything significant.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Both sides claim victory; at stake is whether bombing can keep a state from the bomb, and whether Israel and the US may strike Iran whenever they judge it close.
